ifeval.license: Apache-2.0 (rule verifiers ported/vendored); authored smoke prompts
ifeval.provenance: Phase 1 smoke items authored in this repository using the IFEval instruction-following rule taxonomy (Google, Apache-2.0). Each item is graded by verifiable rules ported here. The real IFEval dataset is loaded with pinned ids in Phase 2; the rule verifiers are the same.

humaneval.license: MIT (authored smoke items; HumanEval itself is MIT)
humaneval.provenance: Phase 1 smoke items authored in this repository in the HumanEval format (function signature + docstring prompt, hidden unit-test 'check'). The real HumanEval dataset (OpenAI, MIT) with its 164 pinned task ids is loaded in Phase 2. The sandboxed unit-test grader with timeouts is identical across phases.

trec6.license: Authored smoke items; TREC data is for research use
trec6.provenance: Phase 1 smoke items authored in this repository using the TREC-6 coarse label taxonomy (ABBR, DESC, ENTY, HUM, LOC, NUM). The real TREC question-classification set is loaded with pinned ids in Phase 2. Grading logic (label extraction and exact match against the 6 classes) is identical across phases.

gsm8k.license: MIT (authored smoke items; GSM8K itself is MIT)
gsm8k.provenance: Phase 1 smoke items authored in this repository in the GSM8K style (grade-school word problem, single integer answer after '####'). The real GSM8K dataset (OpenAI, MIT) is loaded with pinned ids in Phase 2. Grading logic (final-integer extraction and exact match) is identical across phases.

sanity.provenance: Authored in this repository (fleet-bench). MIT. A trivial 3-class check: classify a common word as one of fruit, furniture, or sports equipment.

sdlc.provenance: Authored in this repository (fleet-bench). MIT. A judged suite across six SDLC task types with instance-specific rubrics (four dimensions scored 0 to 5). Judged blind: a judge model scores anonymized responses in randomized order with model ids hidden.
